description.desc:
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.

You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies.

The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
Throws out her hat to strike enemies, slowing and revealing them through walls.

Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown.

Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits.
Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.

Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .
Fire a projectile that <span class="highlight">swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.

McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.
Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.
Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.
Strike in front of you with lightning, applying a charge to the unit or area hit. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.
Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.
Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.
Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.
Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

Send a Spirit Cat forward that grab's targets in its way. Grabbing a Hero will cause an explosion soon after.
Press Ability 1 to manually create the explosion.

Leap at a target to inflict Light Melee damage and slow on nearby enemies.
You may use Pounce on a second target if used within 3s
Deploy a Statue to track enemies in an area. The Ward will also attack enemies recently damaged by {s:hero_name}. Targeted enemies have reduced healing and heal {s:hero_name} when damaged.

Mark your enemies and bathe yourself in shadow to strengthen your attacks and make yourself Invisible. Attacking will only temporarily reveal you. Hitting enemies with Melee damage will reduce their bullet resist (stacking)

Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap.

Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.
Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.
Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting.

Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection
Connection requires line of sight.
Summon a patch of choking thorns that damage and slows enemies in its radius.
Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.
Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.
Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.
Teleport to the targeted location.

Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair.

Alt-cast to throw first card
Create a large ball of scrap that can be thrown, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. The ball takes time to create and you move slower while carrying it.
Latches onto an Enemy, damaging them and healing yourself while attached. Targets must be in line of sight and within max range to stay latched. A successful kill also restores a Bio Blast charge.
Shoots out a blast of consumed remains, damaging and slowing enemies. Multiple hits increase the slow.
Grabs any enemy looked at by Wrecker, putting them in stasis and holding them overhead. Stuns, and damages all captured enemies when finished. Any grabbed NPCs are salvaged.
Launch a flying shadow copy of yourself that you control, teleporting your original body to wherever it lands. The teleport explosion slows enemies and deals damage based on how long you were flying.
Create an area that slows nearby enemies and damages them after a channel. Damage scales with total channel time.
Create a large ball of scrap, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. Nearby enemies take reduced damage.
Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.

Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
Throw a blade, dealing Spirit Damage. The blade then hooks back, applying Spirit Damage again and applying a Slow.
You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.

Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
Create a hexed area on the ground. After a delay, ALL units in the cylindrical area are Petrified. Enemies also suffer Spirit Damage. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.

Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage.

Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

Hex a target, transforming them into a Rabbit for a limited duration.

Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.

Create a Copy of yourself with reduced health and damage. When the clone dies or expires it explodes, dealing Spirit Damage.

The Copy cannot use their Ultimate ability.

Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage.

While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant.

Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.
Target an enemy. You and the target enemy are bound on Stage, unable to leave. All other characters are pushed out of the radius.
Prepare three AMAZING bolts of magic. Each bolt applies a Fading Slow and deals Spirit Damage, increased for every bolt fired.

Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead.

Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points.
Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration.

Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions.
Hex does not interrupt abilities.
Throw a jar that leaves a spreading toxic pool. Enemies caught in the pool are Slowed and Silenced.

Release a wave of spectral spiders that chase enemies and explode, dealing Spirit Damage.

Hit enemies are poisoned, temporarily losing Spirit and Spirit Resist. This effect can stack multiple times.
Apply a Combat Barrier to a target ally and periodically deal Spirit Damage and Slows.

Dealing Spirit Damage builds an increasing Slow. Once full, the buildup is consumed to apply an Immobilize and a burst of Spirit Damage.

This effect has a cooldown per target.
Create a thread of web between two surfaces. Enemies who touch the web take Damage over time, become Slowed and are Revealed.
Use your umbrella to catch a gust of wind that lifts you backwards. You then charge up your umbrella to fire a projectile that explodes on impact.
Activate your relic. Enemy heroes nearby have slowed movement and dashes, and receive damage over time when looking towards you. If enemies look at you long enough, they get cursed.

Throw a projectile, infused with an imp's spirit. It posseses the enemy, dealing Damage over time.

If the target dies while possessed, the imp jumps to another nearby enemy, refreshing its duration.

Performing a Dash or Slide loads your weapon with an empowered bullet that deals bonus Damage, equal to a percentage of your Weapon Damage.

If you're out of bullets, you'll find an extra one. How lucky.
Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, you empower your next shots to deal bonus damage and penetrate enemies.

Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, release a blitz of bullets at the target enemy, dealing bonus Damage.

Enemies can intercept the bullets.
Passively mark nearby enemies with a Brand. Shooting an enemy with a Brand consumes the effect, dealing bonus Damage and granting Fire Rate and Movement Speed.

Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location.

Can be recast within a brief window.
Leap in a target direction. If no direction is chosen, then leap straight up instead.

Gain stacking bonuses every time you dash, double jump, wall jump, or teleport.

Gaining new stacks refreshes the duration.

Fire a line that attaches to the world, allowing you to swing.

Lifethread resets all air jumps and air dashes.

Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration.

The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.

Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.

Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.

You gain bonus sprint speed.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

Any time you secure or deny a Soul from an entity you get ammo back and gain stacking Spirit Power.
At Max Stacks, gain bonus Sprint speed
Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.
When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.
Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

Your next Melee attack heals you.

This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.
Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.

Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Launch an expanding projectile which Curses enemies for a short duration.
Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.
Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.
Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet and Spirit Resist and applies Healing Reduction.

Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.
When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.
Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.
Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.
Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.
Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.
When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.
When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.
Become immune to bullets.
Increases the effectiveness of your healing.
After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.
Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.
Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.
Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.
Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.
Gain a Barrier for a short duration.
Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.
Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.
Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.
Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.
Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.
Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.
Teleport straight ahead.

Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Increases the target's gravity.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.
Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.
Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.
Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.
Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.
Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.
Respawns the hero at the spot they died.

Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.

Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.
Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.
Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.
Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.

Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.
Heal yourself and nearby allies.
Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.
Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.
Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Can be self-cast.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.
When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.
After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.

Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which you float slowly and cannot perform actions. Afterwards you gain Spirit Power, Move Speed, and Spirit Resist.
Can be canceled early.
Activation cancels any active ability.

Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.
Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.
Increases the duration of your abilities and items.
Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.
Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.
Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.
Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.
Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.
Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.
Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.
Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.
Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

Make your weapon fire multishot.

Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.
While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.
After dealing an accumulated 200 spirit damage, your next Heavy Melee Attack deals an additional 200 spirit damage.
When you receive a Boon, automatically heal.
Kills or assists cause an explosion where the victim dies. Kills against heroes have greater radius and damage.
Each hero kill grants permanent Weapon Damage (up to a max of 0 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
You have infinite ammo.

While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.
Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.
After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.
Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.
Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.
Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.
Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.
Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed
Everytime you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Cooldown is per target.
You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Cooldown is per target.
Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.
Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.
Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.
Taking damage grants stacking bullet resist and spirit resist that expires over time.
Gain passive barrier that grants bullet resist and spirit resist. The barrier repairs itself when out of combat.
Throw a censer that leaves a spreading cloud. Enemies caught in the cloud are Slowed and Silenced.

Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.

Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed.

Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.

Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press Ability 2 to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.

Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

Human:Track the last hero you hit. Killing tracked enemies grants bonus souls.

Werewolf:Track any low-health heroes nearby. Killing tracked heroes reduce your cooldowns.
Return back to your human form.
Leap through the air before landing, dealing melee damage and applying slow to nearby enemies while pushing them away.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
